Flowers Foods | Cloud Engineer/Architect | https://example.com/flowers
About the role
Join our IT team as a Cloud Engineer/Architect supporting our enterprise cloud footprint.
Requirements
5+ years administering Office 365 and SharePoint Online. Deep PowerShell scripting.
Experience with Power Platform, Power Automate, and PowerApps. Active Directory and
Azure AD administration. Manage tenant configuration, run patching cycles, respond to
incidents, maintain runbooks. On-call rotation required.
Compensation
$90,000 - $105,000 annually.
